text.short: Not a menu. A sequence the house serves whatever you ordered — soup, salad, beans, potatoes, a side, a vegetable, bread, fries, dessert.
text.table: The Martin Hotel prints its own, in order: a glass of wine, homemade soup, salad, Basque beans, mashed potatoes, a Basque side dish, a vegetable, home-baked bread, hand-cut fries, Martin bread pudding. The entree you chose is one line in a meal of eleven.

kin.how: prints the longest version of it
the seating that goes with it
the institution the sequence came out of

sections.heading: What it does to a dinner for two
sections.body: It removes almost every choice, and with it almost every reason to study a menu. Two people order two entrees and then eat the same nine other things as the table. Whether that reads as romantic is not something this directory decides — but it is the fact that decides it.
